arguments.code:
import json,itertools
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal,ROUND_HALF_UP
D=json.loads(context)
qs={s:[] for s in D['skus']}
for q in D['quotes']:
 x=D['skus'][q['sku']]
 if q['quality']=='approved' and x['demand']<=q['units']<=x['demand']+2 and q['arrival']<=x['deadline']:
  qs[q['sku']].append(q)
V={v['id']:v for v in D['vendors']}
best=None
for picks in itertools.product(*(qs[s] for s in sorted(qs))):
 if any(q['needs_same_vendor_sku'] and next(p for p in picks if p['sku']==q['needs_same_vendor_sku'])['vendor']!=q['vendor'] for q in picks): continue
 units=defaultdict(int); gross=defaultdict(int); skus=defaultdict(set); carbon=sum(q['carbon'] for q in picks)
 for q in picks:
  units[q['vendor']]+=q['units']; gross[q['vendor']]+=q['units']*q['unit_cents']; skus[q['vendor']].add(q['sku'])
 if len(units)<3 or carbon>D['carbon_cap'] or any(units[v]>V[v]['unit_cap'] for v in units): continue
 cost=0
 for v,u in units.items():
  r=V[v]; g=gross[v]
  merch=int((Decimal(g)*(Decimal(10000-r['tier_bps'])/Decimal(10000))).quantize(Decimal('1'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)) if u>=r['tier_units'] else g
  cost+=merch+(0 if g>=r['free_shipping_gross'] else r['shipping_cents'])
  if len(skus[v])>=2 and merch>=r['rebate_merchandise_min']: cost-=r['rebate_cents']
 if best is None or cost<best: best=cost
print(FINAL(str(best)))
